sources.title: Introducing Grok 4.6
sources.evidence: Dated August 12, 2026; announces same-day availability in Cursor, Grok Build and the API. Describes supplemental training, regenerated supervised trajectories and agentic reinforcement learning.

sources.title: Grok 4.6 API model specification
sources.evidence: Exact grok-4.6 documentation and embedded model object specify 500000 context tokens, text/image input, text output, function calling, structured outputs and reasoning efforts low/medium/high/xhigh with high default.

sources.title: Grok 4.6 Model Card, August 12; revised August 17, 2026
sources.evidence: The 42-page card identifies Grok 4.6 as a release in its 1.5T-scale family (printed p 5). Footnote identifies SpaceXAI as a DBA of XAI LLC and interchangeable with xAI. Pages 5–6 describe Cursor collaboration, hosted distribution, text/image input, text output and training. No active count or network topology is supplied. Official PDF opened through web; direct terminal download returned 403.

sources.title: Elon Musk original X post, July 28, 2026
sources.evidence: Official syndication payload identifies Musk and timestamp 2026-07-28T15:20:02Z. The complete relevant sentences name Grok 4.6 as the 1.5T model with improved SFT/RL and target release around August 7. This is prospective size corroboration; the released-model card supplies confirmation, and the target date is superseded by the actual announcement. Original post: https://x.com/elonmusk/status/2082123925283041545.

sources.title: Grok 4.7 Model Card, September 21, 2026
sources.evidence: Reviewed later 30-page card and exact Grok 4.6 comparison entries. It discusses 4.6 training lineage and evaluation results but supplies no 4.6 active count or architectural configuration. No 4.7 figures are transferred.

sources.title: Grok 4.6 help and model lineage
sources.evidence: Co-developer explicitly states Grok 4.6 has the same base as Grok 4.5, pretrained from scratch, and describes the four configurable reasoning efforts. This provides the exact-model base mapping used with the original 4.5 architectural disclosure.

sources.title: Introducing Grok 4.5, July 8, 2026
sources.evidence: Original co-developer announcement explicitly identifies Grok 4.5 as a mixture-of-experts model jointly trained with SpaceXAI. Used only through Cursor's explicit 4.6 same-base relationship; it does not independently report 4.6 expert configuration or active size.

sources.title: Grok 4.6 model reference in Cursor
sources.evidence: Exact 4.6 page lists a 256k context window for Cursor and distinguishes reasoning effort from fast serving. This is a provider-specific limit; the catalog retains the native xAI API 500000-token figure.

sources.title: Enterprise Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Section 4.1 retains ownership of services and underlying models/technology in SpaceXSI or its suppliers; no model intellectual-property rights are transferred. The 4.6 card subjects use to enterprise/consumer terms. Supports proprietary classification, not an open-weight license. Read through web; direct terminal fetch returned 403.

sources.title: Official xai-org model inventory
sources.evidence: Inventory returned only xai-org/grok-1 and xai-org/grok-2 at review, with no Grok 4.6 checkpoint. Corroborates the card's hosted distribution and proprietary terms; inventory absence alone is not treated as proof.

sources.title: Files API
sources.evidence: Documents that file attachments invoke the server-side attachment_search tool automatically. Lists Grok 4.6 support and PDF among file formats; this does not make PDF a native model input modality.

sources.title: API release notes, August 12, 2026
sources.evidence: August 12 entry announces Grok 4.6 on the xAI API with 500k context, text/image inputs and text-only output, independently confirming the launch day and native contract.

name.note: Official display name; exact native API identifier is grok-4.6.

developer.note: Retain normalized xAI developer. The card explicitly equates xAI and SpaceXAI (XAI LLC DBA) and credits development collaboration with Cursor.

family.note: Official Grok release lineage; the card explicitly identifies this as a continuation of Grok 4.5.

release_date.note: Actual public Cursor/Grok Build/API launch, not the July 28 planned August 7 date. No earlier actual public release was established; later cloud-provider rollouts do not replace this date.

open_weights.note: Released through hosted products and APIs under proprietary terms; no 4.6 checkpoint distribution found in the official model inventory.

license.note: Descriptive classification for the hosted model. Service terms retain rights in underlying models; this is not an SPDX open-source license.

parameters_b.note: Nominal total scale: the released-model card labels exact Grok 4.6 as 1.5T-scale; Musk's earlier exact-model post corroborates 1.5T. Converted to 1500 billion, not a reconstructed exact tensor count. Neither source calls this an active-per-token figure.

active_parameters_b.note: No active-per-token count found in the original/revised card, later 4.7 comparisons, co-developer training disclosures or original founder post checked. Do not equate nominal total with active size or import sibling estimates.

architecture.note: Linked inference from explicit first-party lineage: Cursor says 4.6 uses the same base as 4.5, and its original 4.5 research announcement identifies that base as mixture-of-experts. This supports MoE only; Transformer subtype, routing, expert numbers and active dimensions remain undisclosed.

context_window.note: Native xAI API maximum, confirmed in the exact model object. Cursor separately documents 256k. Limits are provider-specific; the 200k native long-context pricing threshold is not the context maximum.

modalities.note: Native input/output modalities match the exact API record. PDF/file handling uses attachment_search; product image generation and other tools do not establish native image output.

reasoning.note: Native feature flag is true; low, medium, high and xhigh reasoning efforts are supported, with high as default.

tool_call.note: The exact grok-4.6 embedded API model specification enables functionCalling; model documentation also describes the capability.

description.value: Reasoning model developed by xAI with Cursor for coding and other knowledge work, with text and image inputs and text output.
description.note: Replace unsupported promotional frontier framing with developer collaboration, intended use and documented modalities.

patch.description: Reasoning model developed by xAI with Cursor for coding and other knowledge work, with text and image inputs and text output.

sources.label: Musk exact-model size disclosure (original X payload)

patch.notes: 1500B is the developer's nominal 1.5T total scale, not an exact weight tally; active parameters remain undisclosed. MoE is a linked inference from Cursor's explicit 4.6 same-base statement and its 4.5 architectural disclosure; expert/router configuration is undisclosed. Context is 500000 tokens on the native xAI API; Cursor documents 256k. Actual release was August 12, superseding the earlier August 7 target. Native text/image inputs and text output exclude file-search and generation tools.

summary: Audited all 14 fields for exact Grok 4.6. Added nominal 1500B total from its released-model card plus original founder disclosure, proprietary licensing, and MoE through an explicit co-developer same-base mapping. Active size and detailed topology remain undisclosed. Confirmed August 12 launch, native 500K context and text/image-to-text reasoning with tools; recorded Cursor's lower context limit and removed promotional description. Later 4.7 card comparisons and training/interpretability searches supplied no additional exact-model active/topology data.
